cards.stem: What single external force acts on an object falling through a vacuum environment?
cards.quote: An object that falls through a vacuum is subjected to only one external force, the gravitational force, expressed as the weight of the object.
cards.hint: Think about the force named in the weight description

cards.stem: What extra force acts on an object falling through the atmosphere?
cards.quote: there is an additional drag force acting on the object
cards.hint: Consider the extra resistance present in air

cards.stem: How is free fall acceleration described at sea level on Earth?
cards.quote: The acceleration is constant and equal to the gravitational acceleration g which is 9.8 meters per square second at sea level on the Earth.
cards.hint: Look for the constant value given for sea level
